```{r}
cpi_model %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(inflation_mom, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(inflation_mom, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(inflation_mom, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(inflation_mom, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(inflation_mom, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
